J-tree Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is located to the northeast of Droplet Island. While this island is available for development, as the original island owner felt that any urban development on this island is not feasible, he returned the development rights of this island on June 2018. Currently, this island remained undeveloped.

title: January 1
safeHtml:
January 1 is the first day of the year in the Gregorian Calendar.

Contents

  • 1 Historical Events
    • 1.1 2014
    • 1.2 2016
    • 1.3 2017
    • 1.4 2020
    • 1.5 2021
  • 2 Citations and References

Historical Events[]

2014[]

  • Nazca Railway Terracept Division Intra-area Railway Line 301, Line 405 Markbear Station began operations. Line 405 is established.

2016[]

  • Nazca Railway Flask Line East Margin Station began operations.
  • Project Nazca established a new Facebook Group.

2017[]

  • Peckern Metro (Then Kasukano Train Railway (KTR)) Tipo Market Station began operations.
  • Nazca Ferry Haber Island Pier completed construction, and would begin operations after the establishment of the Government of Haber Island.
  • Inter-Galactic Media Group (IGMG) began broadcasting NR Journal.

2020[]

  • Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Top Hill Bay Station began operations.

2021[]

  • Nazca Railway Coast Edge Station completed Platform expansion of the Swift Line section.

  • When this station was constructed, the Station Number of Zephyr Line was 11-04. However, due to the construction of Speechless Station and to reserve room for future Centopia development, the Station Number is now 11-05.
  • This Station is named after Princess Jasmine from the movie Aladdin.[3]
  • This Station uses Aerial Platform Gates in order to enable passengers to get a better view of Sparkling Lake.[4]
  • In order to avoid repeated use of the word "Sparkling", this station is named after the beach on which this station is located instead of after the lake itself.
  • To let passengers get a better view, this station uses a lot of glass at the concourse, with the lavatories and Station Control Room placed at each end of the Concourse.[5]
  • The Shopping Street of this station takes reference from Greenrock Hill Station and is 300m long.[6]

History[]

  • August 25 2019: This station began services.
  • November 7 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[7]
  • December 25 2022: Due to the construction of Speechless Station and future Centopia development, the Station Number of Zephyr Line has changed.[8]

Java Beach Station is a station on Utopia Line and New Edward Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nawis Railway Southern Corridor, Southern Corridor Rapid, Southern Corridor Express (Java Beach Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • The livery, name and concourse shape of this station alludes to the programming language Java.
  • The original Station Number of New Edward Line for this station is 4-09, but due to the completion of Twenty Village Station, it is modified to 4-10.[2]
  • The Platform 3 of this station was originally meant to be built as a New Edward Line Spare Platform, but during the Second Stage Upgrading Works, the platform signage has changed from green to the same hue of red as West Ring Line and Expo Line, and became the Reserved Platform of Utopia Line, the second branch line of West Ring Line. At Season 3, Episode 14 Part 1, Platform 3 became the Alighting Platform of Utopia Line, whereas Platform 4 is built as the Boarding Platform.
  • The ends of Platform 4 are curved.

History[]

  • September 16 2016: This station began services alongside New Edward Line.
  • July 27 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • April 9 2020: Due to the construction of Twenty Village Station, the New Edward Line station number of this station is changed to 4-10.[4]
  • May 15 2021: Platform 4 is built for the usage of Utopia Line.
  • May 18 2021: Utopia Line is established.
  • March 18 2023: Exit A2 is added to this station to connect to the Nawis Railway Station of the Same Name. The original Exit A is renumbered Exit A1.
  • December 16 2024: NR Shops have been added to this station.[5]
  • May 7 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[6]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Stereoscopic Transgressor.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Gleams Between the Rails".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Stereoscopic Transgressor 02:30
Phantom Rails Interlace 02:49

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Duo
    • Layers
    • Patience

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2.5
  • Two Players are Required.
  • Look for the presence of coloured wools scattered across the concourse. Arrange them in a specific order.
  • Press the buttons that corresponds to the coloured wools seen at the concourse. Stand on the pressure plates to confirm your answer.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Light Blue Stained Glass Pane.

Fun Facts[]

  • At the time of the station's construction and completion, this station was formerly connected to the old Mayler Airport Station before proceeding to Mayler Station. However, due to Mayler Airport expansion and Delta Line works, that station was never put into use and was demolished.

History[]

  • June 15 2015: This station began services alongside Arcgo Line.
  • May 16 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works. At the same day, Delta Line is established.[3]
  • January 2 2018: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[4]
  • October 16 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]
  • March 2 2024: The Station Title Banner and Station Icons of this station are added.
  • September 14 2024: This station began expansion of the Skyward Line Part.
  • September 16 2024: This station completed expansion.[6]
  • September 21 2024: Skyward Line is established.
  • January 15 2025: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[7]

safeHtml:
Jayler Tunnel is an underwater tunnel in NR Los Sengas Division.

Description[]

  • Number of Tubes: 4
  • Length: 973 m
  • Lines Served: Arcgo Line, Delta Line
  • Location: Jayler Station - Ponsand Island

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • This tunnel is the first underwater tunnel used by Arcgo Line and subsequently Delta Line.
  • This underwater tunnel originally had only 2 tubes. However, with the construction of Delta Line, this tunnel became a 4 tube tunnel.

Fourth Anniversary Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0
  • Just walk to the Concourse and get your souvenir.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station, as well as the island on which this station is located, is named after a groupmate in an orientation camp in which the railway builder participated in.[2] However, it is unclear whether she had requested for the same hue of light blue as the building materials.
  • The concourse of this station is shaped like a conical flask.
  • This station is the last station to undergo expansion in 2019.

History[]

  • September 13 2015: This station began operations alongside West Ring Line.
  • August 10 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • June 19 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • December 6 2019: Stadow Line extends from Tenbal Island Station to this station.
  • July 21 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Johnson Views Station is a station on East Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Punctual.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the second Floating Station to be built, with the first Floating Station being East Margin Station.
  • This station is the first and currently the only station in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division to NOT feature any exits. However, it should be noted that there is a real-life Station in Japan that does not feature any exits.
  • This station is chosen as the venue for the Project Nazca fifth anniversary station.
  • This station is the first of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate a friend of the Railway Builder, with the other two stations being Kelper Mount Station and Newmonth River Station.[3]
  • This station caused East Ring Line to have all available Station Types at the time of its construction (Elevated, Ground, Underground, Island, Pseudoground, Floating).
  • The unheightened Basic Platform Gates of this station, as well as the east-facing platforms, is designed for passengers to look at the sunrise.

History[]

  • June 15 2017: The structure of this station is complete.[4]
  • June 17 2017: This station began services.
